description: Verify that DHCPREQUEST advertises the offered IP via Option 50 (Requested IP Address) matching the OFFER yiaddr (RFC 2131 §4.3.2 MUST)
approach:
[Objective]
The REQUEST tells the chosen server 'I'd like the address you offered me'. Option 50 carries that address; it must equal the yiaddr the OFFER advertised. RFC 2131 §4.3.2 mandates the match.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT → wire: DHCPDISCOVER.
2. Tester → DUT: DHCPOFFER (yiaddr = Y) → harness snapshots Y
3. DUT → wire: DHCPREQUEST
   • Option 50 == Y   ← key check

[Pass condition]
REQUEST.Option50 equals the snapshotted OFFER.yiaddr.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_discover / Fail_no_request — DORA missing
• Fail_request_requested_ip_mismatch — REQUEST.Option50 differs from OFFER.yiaddr

verdicts.Fail_no_discover: No DUT DHCPDISCOVER within the listen window
verdicts.Fail_request_requested_ip_mismatch: DUT DHCPREQUEST Option 50 mismatch with OFFER yiaddr
